title: Smooth cutoff: χ = 1 near a compact K, 0 ≤ χ ≤ 1, compact support inside an open U
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open and K ⊆ U compact (ℝ^P = Eucl P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)). Then there are a C^∞ function χ : ℝ^P → ℝ (ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) χ) and an open set N ⊆ ℝ^P such that 0 ≤ χ(x) ≤ 1 for every x, χ has compact support (HasCompactSupport χ), tsupport χ ⊆ U, K ⊆ N and χ(x) = 1 for every x ∈ N.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U K : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ (χ : Eucl P → ℝ) (N : Set (Eucl P)), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) χ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1) ∧ HasCompactSupport χ ∧ tsupport χ ⊆ U ∧ IsOpen N ∧ K ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, χ x = 1
